# Pulse task #2859: Create notch bands from the EQ graph bottom and show clear filter-creation cursors

Operation: 27688b2e879d6be5d7b781ad738bfed6
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User request19October2026: clicking empty space at the bottom of the EQ graph should create a NOTCH filter. The user corrected their initial wording ('cut') to 'notch'; this is not another low-/high-cut default. Also make pointer/cursor feedback understandable for notch creation and the existing low-cut/high-cut edge creation actions.

Duplicate/context checked: completed2729/PR340? owns established left-edge low-cut/high-pass and right-edge high-cut/low-pass creation plus continuing same-press drag. Its acceptance/history stays intact; verify its actual canonical PR from current ticket rather than relying on that tentative PR number. Current EQ refinement2800/PR407 is merged, local automation removal2855/PR457 merged; preserve all their controls/history. Related slope/Q2801 and visual2731 stay separate. New focused follow-up; do not reopen historical Done tickets or broaden a completed PR.

Behavior: empty graph bottom interior creation zone selects existing canonical notch shape at clicked frequency. Preserve normal interior bell creation and left-edge low-cut/right-edge high-cut defaults; existing-node hit/selection/drag takes precedence so an existing low node is not silently converted or duplicated. Keep corner behavior consistent with existing edge-cut zones (low/high edge wins at corners unless actual current interaction contract requires primary review). Hover feedback must identify the action that the same pointer hit test will execute: recognizable notch, low-cut/high-pass and high-cut/low-pass creation indicators, using the existing cursor/overlay system and Hex theme. Do not use misleading generic resize cursors or a different hover/action zone resolver. Exact zone size can use existing graph geometry metrics; remain usable when resized/compact/expanded and with no hovered creation action while a node/control owns the pointer.

Reuse existing notch DSP/provider/state, stable band identity and atomic creation/continuing-drag protocol. No new filter math, schema, band cap, automation editor or global cursor architecture. Preserve press-create-drag through async acknowledgement, Escape/capture-loss/stale-generation/pending refusals, one Undo/Redo, save/reopen, channel-bank behavior, existing node scroll-slope/Option-Q/edit/listen/delete and spectrum interactions. Record actual supported click/double-click creation semantics; do not invent an additional activation gesture.

Acceptance: actual rendered pointer tests bottom-center notch, ordinary interior bell, both edge cuts and corners, existing-node hit priority, cursor/action agreement, continuous drag/final release, cancellation, Undo/Redo/persistence and minimum/wide graph geometry. Meaningful actual creation commands/shape values, not only pure cursor string tests. Targeted affected local checks then sole merger full exact candidate/review/merge; Ready for Review only after actual canonical merge. Root later finite optimized native appearance/input checklist, no app operation or install from this request. Existing general implementation worker queues after current310 performance checkpoint and455 denormal review return; keep only3ongoingworkers and one writer in EQ/UI. Before implementation use supported canonical intake/attach/verify current source and preserve unrelated work. Alpha no migrations/backcompat. No hostedCI.
